scene: You ride along inside the tow truck's rumbling, cluttered cabin.
beats: Static pops into jaunty synth jazz as the truck rolls to a stop. The door swings wide to a dazzling, buzzing pink glow.
Inside rests a glowing miniature glass pretzel. You slip it into your jacket just as the truck stops and the door opens into the humming neon workshop.
The pug snorts softly and rests its chin on your knee. The truck purrs to a halt, and the door pops open to a kaleidoscope of flickering signs.
picture: Flat side-view across the tow truck's wide cabin interior. On the far left sits a bulky glowing radio. The driver grips the wheel on the left. At centre, the player sits beside a taped glovebox. On the right, a snoring pug curls up on the passenger bench. Through the windshield, Gear Bridge recedes.
shown: a bulky dashboard radio with glowing dials on the left
a taped-shut metal glovebox below the dash at centre
a wrinkled pug snoring softly on the seat on the right

after.label: Step off at Neon Sign Hospital
Stay on
after.beat: The driver waves as you rumble past the glowing hospital, sharing peppermints until the route ends. You transfer to a window-cleaner gondola that hoists you straight up into Rainmaker Rooftops.

variants.scene: The rusty tow truck rumbles onward as sunset bathes the cluttered cabin in violet.
beats: Cheerful synth tunes burst through the fuzz just as brakes squeal. The truck halts, and the door opens to a warm, humming pink glow.
A delicate glass pretzel gleams inside. You pocket the trinket as the truck pulls up and its door creaks wide before a glowing shop.
The sleepy little hound gives a cozy grunt against your leg. The engine idles down, and the door springs open to dazzling neon signs.
variants.ride_on: The driver hands you mints as you cruise past the hospital glow. At the final depot, an outdoor window-cleaner gondola lifts you up to Rainmaker Rooftops.

variants.scene: You jolt along over the bridge while humming {tune} above the noisy engine.
beats: Crisp synth brass blares over the speakers as the truck eases to a stop. Its door unlocks onto a brilliant pink radiance.
Peeling the tape reveals a tiny pretzel spun from glowing glass. Tucking it away, you hear the engine die as bright neon welcomes you outside.
A wrinkly face nuzzles your knee with a contented sigh. The vehicle halts, its door clicking open toward a flurry of colorful lights.
variants.ride_on: Snacking on peppermints, you ride past the hospital into the night. A cable gondola used by window cleaners hoists you right up into Rainmaker Rooftops.

variants.scene: Old paper scraps rustle across the floorboards of the roaring, sunset-lit truck cabin.
beats: Bouncy synth beats fill the air while the heavy truck glides to a stop. The door flings wide into a sea of electric magenta.
You discover a shining glass pretzel tucked inside. It slips into your corduroy coat right as the brakes hiss and the glowing workshop appears.
The chubby dog twitches its paws peacefully against you. Wheels stop turning, and the door swings ajar to reveal a buzzing rainbow of signs.
variants.ride_on: You share driver's peppermints past the glowing hospital wards. When the cab stops, you hop inside a window-cleaner gondola that rises straight to Rainmaker Rooftops.
